description: Store a new prior-incident memory in the semantic_memory table with a real Titan Text v2 embedding, making the incident retrievable by future memory_search_similar lookups. Call this after a finding is resolved, remediated, or closed to close the RAG loop. Deduplication is automatic: repeated stores of the same summary + cve_id return the existing memory instead of creating a duplicate.

summary.description: Human-readable TLDR of the incident, embedded via Bedrock Titan Text v2. Recommended format: '<CVE> on <asset_name> (<exposure>/<severity>): <decision>, outcome: <outcome>'.

incident_jsonb.description: Structured incident data. Common keys: cve_id, asset_name, exposure, severity, decision, outcome, timestamp. Used for JSONB pre-filtering in later searches.

idempotency_key.description: Optional stable dedup key. When omitted, a key is derived from summary + incident_jsonb.cve_id so repeated runs do not create duplicate memories.
